item.title: Entry for emergency aid does not require probable cause
item.description: The emergency-aid exception is neither a Terry stop nor a criminal investigation. It has its own standard: objective reasonableness based on the totality of circumstances

item.title: From call taker to problem solver: Breaking the cycle with evidence-based policing
item.description: Evidence-based, problem-oriented policing helps officers reduce repeat crime, solve chronic problems and reclaim pride in the job

item.title: R.I. PD credits good Samaritan with stopping shooter who killed 2 at youth hockey game
item.description: Pawtucket PD Chief Tina Goncalves credited an unnamed spectator who intervened, bringing the attack “to a swift end;" Goncalves also stated the shooter died from an apparently self-inflicted gunshot wound

item.title: Detroit PD chief says he will fire officers who contacted Border Patrol during traffic stops
item.description: In 2025 incidents, an officer investigating a felony warrant contacted CBP after suspecting the individual was not a U.S. citizen and a sergeant called CBP for translation help

item.title: N.J. officer 'arrests' Luke Bryan during unforgettable 'American Idol' audition
item.description: Sea Girt Officer Julia Santiago jokingly "arrested" Luke Bryan before wowing the judges and scoring a golden ticket to Hollywood Week

item.title: Md. governor signs bill banning local 287(g) agreements with ICE
item.description: Eight Maryland county sheriff’s offices and the Wicomico County Corrections Center previously participated in 287(g) programs

item.title: Ind. officer fatally shot, second officer wounded
item.description: Officer Brian Elliott was responding to a call when he and another officer were shot; Elliott later died from his injuries

item.title: BWC: Man lures Wash. officers with fake 911 call, slashes one across the face in knife ambush
item.description: Video shows the suspect speaking with Bellevue officers before producing a knife and slashing one in the face; when the officer fell, the man tried to stab him in the back

item.title: Mich. PD to switch from Sig P320 to Glock Gen 6, chief cites safety concerns
item.description: The Grand Blanc Township board approved a motion to purchase 50 Glock Gen 6 9MM handguns with sights, along with new holsters and other equipment for $48,256.50
